The APC has kicked off its 2027 re-election campaign in Kaduna, with President Bola Tinubu defending his administration’s record and seeking another four-year mandate.
While the President blames previous administrations for hunger and poverty, his government says it is working to address these challenges through economic reforms and relief measures.
However, many Nigerians are still struggling with the high cost of food, transportation and other basic necessities.
